LanguageData.MST.StockGenNonVanilla: Non-vanilla type (added by another mod): only the type name is shown, and only its inherited vanilla fields can be edited
LanguageData.MST.StockGenUnsupported: Editing this field type is not supported; value kept
LanguageData.MST.requestableComment: Whether the player can request this trader to come via the comms console.
LanguageData.MST.hideThingsNotWillingToTradeComment: Hide things this trader is not willing to trade in the trade window.
LanguageData.MST.categoryComment: Free-text category tag (vanilla uses Slaver, TributeCollector...). Only affects display grouping.
LanguageData.MST.tradeCurrencyComment: Currency used for trading: Silver, or Favor (requires Royalty).
LanguageData.MST.permitRequiredForTradingComment: Requires holding this imperial permit to trade (requires Royalty).
LanguageData.MST.commonalityMultFromPopulationIntentC: Curve multiplying commonality by population intent.
LanguageData.MST.stockGeneratorsComment: Stock generator list. The field holds the generator objects directly; click Edit to change entries one by one: each row is a generator (class name + key field summary) and can be added (vanilla types only), moved up/down or removed; every generator field gets a text box, dropdown or sub-list window depending on its kind. Non-vanilla (mod-added) types show only the class name and allow editing only their inherited vanilla fields. Saves as one line of field text per generator; copy/paste also works line by line (paste is validated as a whole).
